Hello everyone,

I have a similar problem than Prescilia. I run the code and the Record_Table file shows me 3 events of one species (Galictis vittata), when actually is just one event with 3 consecutive photos. The minDeltaTime is 60 minutes. I’m sure that I only have one event of this species because I only registered it once in one camera trap. I check for more possible errors and I found similar problems when the photos were taken by a Cover Illuminator camera trap, and not with Bushnell TrophyCam. Juergen, do you have any suggestion?

Another problem. I run the code until the end, but the .zip file wasn't generated, even though I selected True on that option. I updated my R version trying to solve the problem but not change. A friend runs the exact same code (we used a hard drive) and she was able to generate the .zip file. Did anybody have the same problem?

Cheers,

Álvaro

Hi Álvaro,
I had a look at the images you sent me and the metadata looked fine to me. What is odd though is that there is a 5 - 6 second difference between the time in the data field in the bottom of the image and in the metadata. But that should not affect the outcome much.
I tried to reproduce the problem, but was not successful. I used recordTable with arguments:

minDeltaTime = 60,
deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastRecord"

However I only found 1 record of Galictis vittata in the record table. 





Even with minDeltaTime = 0 I only get 1 record, as all 3 images have the same time in the metadata. Only if I set removeDuplicateRecords = FALSE, I get 3 records. Could that be the issue here?
If so I should fix it in the code.
